verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a first-party Importer plugin that converts a Notion workspace to Markdown, preserving databases and formulas as Bases. Its import docs also list Evernote, OneNote and Airtable sources. Plain Markdown needs no conversion, since a vault is just a folder of Markdown files you can open directly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that internal links and attachments are preserved on import, any documented Roam importer (only one anecdotal Roam migration), and independent hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.
